question: Should OpenClaw accept the new QuickJS `agents.run`/`phase`/`log` orchestration API as the supported Swarm surface under `tools.swarm` once restart-safety proof is complete?
rationale: This PR adds a durable user-facing scripting API and persisted recovery behavior; the linked proposal documents intent, but the supplied context does not establish a maintainer-confirmed permanent API contract.

options.title: Accept the scoped Swarm API
options.body: Keep the proposed opt-in API, provided the current head proves restart-safe replay and documents the supported semantics.

options.title: Narrow the first API
options.body: Limit the initial surface to collector launch and completion, deferring progress globals or other permanent guest API commitments.

options.title: Defer API acceptance
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer confirms the long-term Code Mode orchestration contract and compatibility expectations.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped Swarm API
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed opt-in API, provided the current head proves restart-safe replay and documents the supported semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked proposal and the current implementation, so they are the clearest available person to clarify the intended feature contract.
